names.legendary: The Glass That Stopped Time

lore.common: Gets stared at by everyone during the board game instead of the board.
lore.uncommon: Is turned over so late that the timer has already run out.
lore.rare: Slows its sand down whenever someone is losing, and speeds up when they're winning.
lore.epic: Ran out mid-answer at the family quiz, and the whole room shouted at a little glass of sand.
lore.legendary: Was turned over at the start of a picnic and the sand stopped halfway, so the afternoon lasted all summer.

names.legendary: Captain Stickybrave of the First Aid Box

lore.common: Pulls out every little hair when it's peeled off.
lore.uncommon: Has cartoon animals printed on it, so children ask for one even without a scratch.
lore.rare: Makes every scraped knee stop hurting the moment it's stuck on, or so everyone agrees.
lore.epic: Patched up every knee at sports day, and the first aid box ran out by lunch.
lore.legendary: Was stuck on a teddy's paw after a fall from the bunk bed, and teddy made a full recovery.

names.legendary: The Glass That Called Every Storm

lore.common: Gets tapped on the glass every morning to make its needle move.
lore.uncommon: Hangs in the hall with a shiny brass face and words like Fair and Stormy.
lore.rare: Drops its needle to Stormy just before the picnic, and is always right.
lore.epic: Warned the whole village of the storm, and everyone tied down their washing just in time.
lore.legendary: Has predicted every big storm for a hundred years, and the fishermen won't sail without checking it.

names.legendary: The Mirror That Saw Everything Behind

lore.common: Folds itself back when brushed by a passing cyclist.
lore.uncommon: Shows objects closer than they appear, which makes parking a nightmare.
lore.rare: Spies on the back seat so well that no argument goes unnoticed.
lore.epic: Got knocked by every car in the narrow lane, and the whole street had their mirrors folded.
lore.legendary: Saw a lost dog trotting behind the car for three streets, and reunited it with its family.

names.legendary: The Screen That Guarded the Hearth

lore.common: Gets knocked over by the cat chasing its own tail.
lore.uncommon: Has brass legs that get too hot to touch.
lore.rare: Catches every spark that jumps out of the fire before it hits the rug.
lore.epic: Glowed so warmly in front of the fire that the whole family sat round it all winter.
lore.legendary: Has guarded the same fireplace for two hundred years without letting a single spark land on the rug.

names.legendary: The Match That Lit the Lantern

lore.common: Snaps in half the first time it's struck.
lore.uncommon: Flares up with a fizz that makes everyone step back.
lore.rare: Is glued with thousands of others into models that look like real houses.
lore.epic: Was built into a whole model village, with a church tower, a school and a tiny bus stop.
lore.legendary: Lit the lantern that guided a whole hiking group back down the mountain.

names.legendary: The Dial That Counted to the Moon

lore.common: Clicks its numbers so slowly that the children count with it.
lore.uncommon: Rolls its little numbers over like a tiny slot machine.
lore.rare: Turns round to a big round number just as the family is watching.
lore.epic: Rolled over to all zeros on the motorway, and the whole family cheered at once.
lore.legendary: Counted enough miles to drive to the moon and back, all in one old family car.

names.legendary: Sir Plungeworth the Fearless

lore.common: Pops off with a loud slurp at exactly the wrong moment.
lore.uncommon: Thumps up and down in the sink until something gurgles.
lore.rare: Unblocks drains so fast that the plumber asks how it did it.
lore.epic: Unblocked every sink in the house on the morning of the big party, and the guests never knew.
lore.legendary: Rescued a lost wedding ring from the drain with one mighty pull.

names.legendary: The Tripod That Never Shook

lore.common: Has one leg that's always shorter than the others.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on the sand so every photo tilts slightly.
lore.rare: Holds the camera so still that every star is sharp.
lore.epic: Stood in a row with fifty others at sunrise, and the whole beach looked like a photo studio.
lore.legendary: Held the camera still for a whole night to photograph the stars spinning round the sky.

names.legendary: The Mirror That Winked Back

lore.common: Gets spotted with toothpaste every single morning.
lore.uncommon: Shows its owner their morning face, which nobody wants to see.
lore.rare: Makes a small room look twice as big, and the cat keeps trying to walk into it.
lore.epic: Covered the whole dance studio wall, and every dancer could see what everyone else was doing wrong.
lore.legendary: Has reflected the same family's faces for a hundred years and never once cracked.

names.legendary: Professor Waveform of the Lab

lore.common: Shows a wiggly green line that everyone pretends to understand.
lore.uncommon: Has so many knobs that every visitor twists one, and the line jumps off the screen.
lore.rare: Catches sound waves and shows them dancing on the screen.
lore.epic: Showed every pupil's voice as a squiggle, and the science lab became a singing contest.
lore.legendary: Caught the wobble in a broken radio that nobody else could find, and fixed it in one afternoon.

names.legendary: The Bag That Was Used Forever

lore.common: Gets caught in trees and flaps there for months.
lore.uncommon: Lives in another bag full of bags under the kitchen sink.
lore.rare: Floats away on the wind like a jellyfish and lands on the beach.
lore.epic: Blew out of every bin in the car park, and the whole place looked like a ghost town.
lore.legendary: Was reused for twenty years and carried a thousand shopping trips before finally being recycled.

names.legendary: The Watch That Knew Everything

lore.common: Buzzes your wrist every five minutes about something you don't care about.
lore.uncommon: Tells you to stand up every time you sit down.
lore.rare: Tells everyone at breakfast how badly you slept.
lore.epic: Buzzed on every wrist in the meeting at once, and everyone checked them at the same moment.
lore.legendary: Noticed its owner's heart beating oddly and sent her to the doctor just in time.

names.legendary: The Roll That Never Ran Out

lore.common: Runs out exactly when you need it most.
lore.uncommon: Is always hung the wrong way round, according to someone in the house.
lore.rare: Unrolls itself across the bathroom whenever the cat walks past.
lore.epic: Was unrolled by the puppy through the whole house, out the door and round the garden.
lore.legendary: Lasted a whole month in a family of six, which nobody can explain.

names.legendary: The Bin That Ate the Street

lore.common: Bangs its lid at night when the wind blows.
lore.uncommon: Smells so bad on hot days that the flies queue up.
lore.rare: Gets knocked over by the fox every night, and the rubbish ends up in the garden.
lore.epic: Rolled down the hill on bin day and knocked over every other bin on the street.
lore.legendary: Swallowed so much rubbish at the street party that it needed two bin lorries to empty.

names.legendary: The Clock That Ran Backwards

lore.common: Ticks so loudly at night that nobody can sleep.
lore.uncommon: Runs five minutes fast, so the whole family is always early.
lore.rare: Slows down during the last lesson of the day so it lasts forever.
lore.epic: Was stared at by the whole school during the last lesson before the holidays.
lore.legendary: Ran backwards for one afternoon, and the whole class got an extra hour of art.

names.legendary: The Blind That Never Closed Fully

lore.common: Gets its slats tangled so half point up and half point down.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck halfway up so you have to duck under it.
lore.rare: Lets the morning sun stripe across your face at five in the morning.
lore.epic: Snapped up with a bang at the sleepover, and every child woke up at once.
lore.legendary: Has been stuck at half-mast for twenty years, and the family now calls it a feature.

names.legendary: The Curtain That Hid Every Child

lore.common: Slips off one hook so it droops at the corner.
lore.uncommon: Is the first place every child hides during hide and seek, with their feet showing.
lore.rare: Leaks a stripe of light right onto your pillow at dawn.
lore.epic: Hid every child at the party at once, and the grown-ups pretended not to see the line of shoes.
lore.legendary: Has hidden three generations of children during hide and seek, and has never once given them away.

names.legendary: The Doors That Opened Summer

lore.common: Has a handle that sticks every winter.
lore.uncommon: Lets the garden in, along with every fly in it.
lore.rare: Swings open in the breeze and knocks over the plant pot.
lore.epic: Was flung open for the summer party, and the whole garden came inside.
lore.legendary: Has been opened on the first warm day of spring for a hundred years, and summer always follows.

names.legendary: The Door That Welcomed Everyone

lore.common: Snaps its letterbox on your fingers when you post a card.
lore.uncommon: Needs its key jiggled just right before it opens.
lore.rare: Swings open just as you knock, so you fall into the hall.
lore.epic: Was opened by every guest at the party at once, and the hall turned into a traffic jam.
lore.legendary: Has welcomed every member of the family home for a hundred years.

names.legendary: The Door That Revealed the Band

lore.common: Rumbles so loudly when opening that the whole street hears it.
lore.uncommon: Jams halfway up, so you have to crawl under it.
lore.rare: Has a basketball hoop above it that rattles every time it opens.
lore.epic: Lifted up to reveal the garage band, and the whole street came to listen.
lore.legendary: Has opened on the same family car for forty years and only jammed once, on the morning of a wedding.

names.legendary: The Glass That Nobody Saw

lore.common: Gets walked into by people who think it's open.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in nose and hand prints at exactly toddler height.
lore.rare: Looks so clean that a pigeon tries to fly through it every day.
lore.epic: Was walked into by half the shoppers on the first day of the sale.
lore.legendary: Has been cleaned so perfectly for fifty years that a whole family thinks it's not there.

names.legendary: The Curtain With a Hundred Ducks

lore.common: Clings to your legs while you shower like a wet ghost.
lore.uncommon: Grows a little black line at the bottom that nobody can scrub off.
lore.rare: Lets the water spray out the side and flood the floor.
lore.epic: Let so much water out during one shower that the bathroom floor became a paddling pool.
lore.legendary: Has a hundred ducks printed on it, and the toddler has named every single one.

names.legendary: The Shutters of the Seaside House

lore.common: Creaks open by itself at dawn, letting a stripe of sunlight onto the sleeping cat.
lore.uncommon: Slams shut in a storm so loudly that everyone jumps.
lore.rare: Peels its paint in the sun, so it's a different colour every year.
lore.epic: Slammed shut on every house on the seafront when the storm came in.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same seaside house safe through a hundred storms.

names.legendary: The Window to the Sky

lore.common: Patters so loudly in the rain that nobody can sleep.
lore.uncommon: Shows the stars from bed on a clear night.
lore.rare: Collects leaves in autumn until the room goes dark.
lore.epic: Showed a whole meteor shower to a family lying on the bedroom floor.
lore.legendary: Has shown the same attic room the stars every clear night for fifty years.

names.legendary: The Window That Watched the Street

lore.common: Fogs up every morning so you have to draw on it.
lore.uncommon: Lets in every fly in summer and won't let them out.
lore.rare: Makes everyone in class look outside instead of at the board.
lore.epic: Was looked out of by every pupil at once when snow started, and the lesson stopped.
lore.legendary: Has watched the same street for a hundred years and seen every child grow up.

names.legendary: The Oldest Pane in the House

lore.common: Rattles in its frame every time a lorry goes by.
lore.uncommon: Drips condensation down onto the windowsill every morning.
lore.rare: Lets in a thin draught that blows out every candle.
lore.epic: Was hammered by a hailstorm, and every child in the house came to watch it hold.
lore.legendary: Has been in the same window for two hundred years and is a tiny bit thicker at the bottom.

names.legendary: The Bandage That Made a Mummy

lore.common: Unravels down the corridor as you walk.
lore.uncommon: Is wrapped so many times round a tiny cut that the finger looks like a sausage.
lore.rare: Turns any child into a mummy in under a minute.
lore.epic: Wrapped up every child at the fancy dress party, and there were twenty mummies.
lore.legendary: Wrapped a whole teddy bear hospital's worth of patients in one afternoon.

names.legendary: The Mirror That Heard Every Song

lore.common: Fogs up so completely after a shower that you see nothing at all.
lore.uncommon: Gets messages written in the steam that appear again next time.
lore.rare: Opens into a cupboard full of old plasters and toothpaste tubes.
lore.epic: Had the whole family queuing in front of it on the first morning of the holiday.
lore.legendary: Has heard every family member sing in the shower for thirty years and never told.

names.legendary: Professor Bubblesworth of the Lab

lore.common: Spills over the moment it's filled to the top.
lore.uncommon: Has measurements on the side that are never quite right.
lore.rare: Fizzes so much when things are mixed that it bubbles out of the top.
lore.epic: Bubbled over in the science lab, and the whole class had foam up to their knees.
lore.legendary: Mixed the first ever science experiment of a girl who grew up to be a famous inventor.

names.legendary: The Seat With Too Many Buttons

lore.common: Has buttons that nobody dares press.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water when you least expect it.
lore.rare: Warms itself up so nicely that nobody wants to leave the bathroom.
lore.epic: Sprayed every visitor at the hotel who pressed the wrong button.
lore.legendary: Has a remote control with thirty buttons, and only one person in the family knows them all.

names.legendary: The Bag That Made It to the Lorry

lore.common: Drips something mysterious down your leg on the way to the bin.
lore.uncommon: Is tied so full that the knot won't close, so it wears its rubbish like a hat.
lore.rare: Gets ripped open by a fox every night it's left outside.
lore.epic: Split open on bin day and covered the whole pavement in yoghurt pots.
lore.legendary: Made it from the kitchen to the bin lorry without a single tear, which no bag has ever done.

names.legendary: The Strap That Saved the Binoculars

lore.common: Rubs the back of your neck until it's red.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself into a knot in the bottom of the bag.
lore.rare: Caught the binoculars as they slipped over the side of the boat.
lore.epic: Tangled with every other strap in the hide, and the birdwatchers were tied together all morning.
lore.legendary: Saved its binoculars from falling off a cliff, and the owner still tells everyone about it.

names.legendary: The Viewer on the Clifftop

lore.common: Swallows your coin and gives you ten seconds of looking.
lore.uncommon: Points at the sea, the sky and the same seagull every time.
lore.rare: Showed a seal on the rocks that nobody else could see.
lore.epic: Had a queue all summer on the pier, and everyone saw the same boat.
lore.legendary: Has stood on the same clifftop for eighty years and shown a million people the lighthouse.

names.legendary: Ninety-Nine Flames at Once

lore.common: Lights itself again every time the birthday child blows it out.
lore.uncommon: Dribbles wax onto the icing so the first slice has a crunchy bit.
lore.rare: Grants exactly one wish a year, but only if every flame goes out in one breath.
lore.epic: Had so many lit on grandpa's cake that the smoke alarm sang the birthday song.
lore.legendary: Burned on a ninety-ninth birthday cake, and the birthday girl blew them all out first try.

names.legendary: Big Crackle of the Village Green

lore.common: Sends its smoke in whatever direction you move your chair.
lore.uncommon: Spits sparks into the sky like a little firework display of its own.
lore.rare: Cooks sausages so slowly that everyone eats them half raw and pretends not to mind.
lore.epic: Crackled so loudly on bonfire night that the fireworks had to wait their turn.
lore.legendary: Was built so carefully by the whole village that it burned for exactly as long as the party lasted.

names.legendary: The Fire That Told Ghost Stories

lore.common: Turns every marshmallow into a black lump the moment it gets near.
lore.uncommon: Tumbles a log over in the middle of the best story.
lore.rare: Pops a loud spark exactly at the scariest moment of every ghost story.
lore.epic: Got the whole campsite singing round it until the owls asked for quiet.
lore.legendary: Kept a group of lost hikers warm all night until the rescue team found them by its glow.

names.legendary: Grandmaster Tick-Tock

lore.common: Gets its button slapped so hard that it slides across the table.
lore.uncommon: Drops its little red flag the moment someone runs out of time.
lore.rare: Ticks faster whenever the player is thinking hard.
lore.epic: Ran out on every board at the tournament at once, and fifty players gasped together.
lore.legendary: Timed a game so long that the players finished it the next morning in their pyjamas.

names.legendary: Lady Reflectina of the Purse

lore.common: Clicks open in the handbag and gets powder everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Has two mirrors, one that makes your nose look enormous.
lore.rare: Clicks shut so loudly in a quiet library that every reader looks up at once.
lore.epic: Signalled across the whole beach to find a lost friend, and twenty people waved back.
lore.legendary: Was used to signal a passing ship from a stranded rowing boat, and the ship turned round.

names.legendary: The Heap That Grew a Pumpkin

lore.common: Smells like old banana skins on warm days.
lore.uncommon: Is the busiest worm hotel in the garden.
lore.rare: Steams on cold mornings like it's breathing.
lore.epic: Grew so many surprise tomato plants that the whole garden became a jungle.
lore.legendary: Grew a pumpkin so big on its own that it won first prize at the show, without anyone planting it.

names.legendary: The Paper Ball That Scored

lore.common: Misses the bin every single time it's thrown.
lore.uncommon: Gets unfolded later because someone realises the idea was good after all.
lore.rare: Turns into a perfect ball for office basketball.
lore.epic: Was thrown at the bin by everyone in the office, and the floor became a paper sea.
lore.legendary: Was uncrumpled years later and found to hold the first draft of a famous song.

names.legendary: The Bird That Never Missed an Hour

lore.common: Shouts cuckoo at midnight and wakes the whole house.
lore.uncommon: Has pinecone-shaped weights on chains that need pulling every day.
lore.rare: Pops its little bird out so fast that it surprises the cat every hour.
lore.epic: Cuckooed with every clock in the shop at once, and the shopkeeper covered his ears.
lore.legendary: Has called out every hour for a hundred years without once missing one.

names.legendary: Wakeywakey the Unignorable

lore.common: Glows so red in the dark that you can read by it.
lore.uncommon: Flashes 12:00 for weeks after every power cut, and the whole family has given up resetting it.
lore.rare: Beeps louder each time it's ignored.
lore.epic: Went off in every bedroom of the school trip at the same time, and everyone woke at six.
lore.legendary: Woke a family just in time to catch the only flight to their holiday.

names.legendary: The Handle That Shocked Everyone

lore.common: Sticks every time you try to open it with full hands.
lore.uncommon: Gets opened with elbows by everyone carrying shopping.
lore.rare: Gives a tiny static shock to everyone wearing woolly socks.
lore.epic: Jammed on the first day of the sales, and a hundred shoppers waited outside.
lore.legendary: Has been turned by every member of the family a million times and still clicks the same.

names.legendary: The Knocker That Woke the House

lore.common: Thuds so loudly that the whole house jumps.
lore.uncommon: Has a brass lion's face that stares at every visitor.
lore.rare: Echoes down the hallway so the knock sounds like three people.
lore.epic: Was knocked by every child on dress-up night, and the house shook all evening.
lore.legendary: Knocked so loudly once that it woke a grandad who'd been napping since lunch.

names.legendary: The Knob That Came Off in Your Hand

lore.common: Rattles when you turn it, as if it's about to fall off.
lore.uncommon: Comes off in your hand at the worst moment.
lore.rare: Gets a sock hung on it to say do not disturb.
lore.epic: Fell off on the inside, and the whole family had to climb out of the window.
lore.legendary: Fell off and was found in the garden fifty years later by a gardener digging potatoes.

names.legendary: The Big Green Bin Behind the Market

lore.common: Slams its lid so loudly that the whole alley echoes.
lore.uncommon: Is a restaurant for every rat, fox and seagull in town.
lore.rare: Overflows so far that the rubbish makes a little mountain next to it.
lore.epic: Was filled by every stall after market day, and the bin lorry needed two trips.
lore.legendary: Swallowed so much rubbish after the town festival that it creaked when it was emptied.

names.legendary: The Lift That Never Stopped at Four

lore.common: Plays the same tinny tune every single journey.
lore.uncommon: Has every button pressed by a small child.
lore.rare: Gets stuck between floors for exactly as long as it takes to panic.
lore.epic: Squeezed in every worker at nine o'clock, and nobody could press their own button.
lore.legendary: Has carried a million people up and down the same building and still won't stop at the fourth floor.

names.legendary: The Pit That Warmed the Whole Garden

lore.common: Swaps its smoke to whoever sits down next.
lore.uncommon: Toasts everyone's feet while their backs freeze.
lore.rare: Glows so warmly that the cats from three gardens away come to sit by it.
lore.epic: Kept the whole garden party warm until midnight in November.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole street's neighbours warm through the power cut, and they all became friends.

names.legendary: The Hearth That Every Cat Loved

lore.common: Sends soot down the chimney onto the clean rug.
lore.uncommon: Spits a little ember out onto the hearth rug every evening.
lore.rare: Draws every family member to sit in front of it until there's no room.
lore.epic: Warmed the whole house through the coldest snowstorm, and nobody wanted to go to bed.
lore.legendary: Has had the same family cat asleep in front of it for every evening of its life.

names.legendary: The Rocket That Wrote in the Sky

lore.common: Makes everyone wait so long after lighting that they think it's gone out.
lore.uncommon: Bangs so loudly that every dog in the street hides.
lore.rare: Paints the sky with colours that hang there for a whole second.
lore.epic: Went off at the wrong end of the field, and the crowd spun round so fast that everyone swapped seats.
lore.legendary: Exploded into a shape so perfect that the whole town still argues whether it was a smiley face.

names.legendary: The Box That Fixed Every Knee

lore.common: Has a thousand plasters and none in the right size.
lore.uncommon: Is green with a white cross so everyone can find it.
lore.rare: Hides its little scissors so nobody can find them when needed.
lore.epic: Patched up every scraped knee at sports day, and ran out of plasters by the relay.
lore.legendary: Has patched up every child in the school for twenty years, and is now mostly plasters.

names.legendary: Medic Mitzi of the Mountain Path

lore.common: Has a zip that always sticks when someone is crying.
lore.uncommon: Rolls out its gauze bandage across the floor.
lore.rare: Is always ready in the rucksack, even though nobody packed it.
lore.epic: Patched up a whole hiking group after a tumble on the scree.
lore.legendary: Went up every mountain with the same climber and never had to be used once.

names.legendary: The Flare That Called the Lifeboat

lore.common: Fizzes so brightly that everyone has to look away.
lore.uncommon: Pours out bright red smoke that turns the whole beach pink.
lore.rare: Signals from so far out at sea that the coastguard sees it from the lighthouse.
lore.epic: Lit up the whole bay during the lifeboat drill, and every boat turned to look.
lore.legendary: Called the lifeboat to a stranded fishing boat, and every fisherman got home for tea.

names.legendary: The Mirror That Approved Every Outfit

lore.common: Makes everyone check their outfit three times before leaving.
lore.uncommon: Leans against the wall and wobbles when anyone walks past.
lore.rare: Makes the bedroom look like it has twins in it.
lore.epic: Watched the whole family try on costumes for the party, and the bedroom turned into a fashion show.
lore.legendary: Has seen a hundred first-day-of-school outfits and approved every single one.

names.legendary: The Globe That Planned a Gap Year

lore.common: Gets spun so fast that the countries blur together.
lore.uncommon: Gets stopped by a finger that always lands in the sea.
lore.rare: Lands on a country that its owner can't pronounce.
lore.epic: Was spun by every pupil in geography, and the class planned trips to fifty countries.
lore.legendary: Landed on the same island three times in a row, so its owner finally went there.

names.legendary: The Clock That Outlived Grandfather

lore.common: Bongs a minute late every hour, so the whole house checks their watches.
lore.uncommon: Has to be wound up with a chain every Sunday.
lore.rare: Swings its pendulum so steadily that everyone in the room breathes in time.
lore.epic: Chimed thirteen times at midnight, and the whole house came downstairs to check.
lore.legendary: Has stood in the same hallway for two hundred years and still keeps perfect time.

names.legendary: The Cone That Scented the Market

lore.common: Hangs its smoke in the room like a curtain.
lore.uncommon: Smells of spice and flowers so strongly that the cat sneezes.
lore.rare: Fills the whole house with a smell that lasts a week.
lore.epic: Was lit at every stall at the night market, and the street smelled like a garden.
lore.legendary: Scented a whole bookshop so pleasantly that customers stayed to read all afternoon.

names.legendary: The Puffer That Helped Win the Race

lore.common: Hides in the bottom of the school bag until it's needed.
lore.uncommon: Has to be shaken before every puff, and it rattles.
lore.rare: Helps its owner breathe easily on the coldest, frostiest morning.
lore.epic: Went with its owner on the cross-country race, and she finished ahead of the whole class.
lore.legendary: Helped a girl run her first marathon, and she crossed the finish line with it in her pocket.

names.legendary: The Keyhole That Saw the Surprise

lore.common: Gets peeked through by every curious child in the house.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone miss it with the key in the dark.
lore.rare: Whistles in the wind like a tiny flute.
lore.epic: Was peeked through by every guest at the surprise party, and the surprise was ruined.
lore.legendary: Has been looked through by three generations of nosy children and kept every secret.

names.legendary: Professor Fizzworth of the Lab

lore.common: Bubbles over the moment it's heated.
lore.uncommon: Gets swirled round by everyone who holds it, like a fancy drink.
lore.rare: Changes colour when two liquids are mixed, and the class gasps.
lore.epic: Made a volcano at the science fair that foamed over three tables.
lore.legendary: Held the experiment that won the science fair, a potion that turned blue then gold then blue again.

names.legendary: The Hill That Became a Park

lore.common: Is covered in seagulls arguing over crusts.
lore.uncommon: Grows a little taller every week as the lorries arrive.
lore.rare: Is so big that the diggers look like toys on top of it.
lore.epic: Was visited by every seagull in the county at once, and the sky went white.
lore.legendary: Was covered in soil and trees, and is now the town's favourite park with a view.

names.legendary: The Last Wrapper on the Beach

lore.common: Blows down the pavement and lands in someone's garden.
lore.uncommon: Gets carried by the wind into the one garden that has just been tidied.
lore.rare: Escapes the bin in the wind and tours the whole park.
lore.epic: Was picked up by the whole school on litter-pick day, and the park sparkled.
lore.legendary: Was blown on the wind across three counties, and was finally picked up by a heron building its nest.

names.legendary: The Lens That Found the Lost Earring

lore.common: Focuses the sun into a hot little spot that makes everyone step back.
lore.uncommon: Makes every bug in the garden look like a monster.
lore.rare: Reads the smallest print on the cereal box.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole class on bug hunt day, and the garden was full of explorers.
lore.legendary: Found a lost earring in the thick carpet after three days of everyone looking.

names.legendary: Inspector Lensworth the Observant

lore.common: Makes everyone who holds it want to play detective.
lore.uncommon: Shows every smudge on the window as a huge fingerprint.
lore.rare: Watches the ants so closely that they seem to watch back.
lore.epic: Was used by the whole detective club to find the missing biscuits, and the dog was guilty.
lore.legendary: Solved the mystery of the missing birthday cake by spotting icing on the dog's whiskers.

names.legendary: Madame Glimmerlights of the Theatre

lore.common: Has bulbs all round it that make the room very hot.
lore.uncommon: Zooms in so close that every freckle looks like a planet.
lore.rare: Hogs all the light in the room, so everyone else is in shadow.
lore.epic: Lit up every face in the theatre dressing room before the show, and every actor looked their best.
lore.legendary: Has seen a hundred actors get ready for opening night, and every one of them was a success.

names.legendary: The Single Match That Lit Every Candle

lore.common: Goes out the moment it's lit, every single time, with a little puff of smoke.
lore.uncommon: Gets damp and won't strike no matter how hard you try.
lore.rare: Needs three strikes before it lights, and then goes out straight away.
lore.epic: Lit every candle in the house during the power cut, and the family played cards by candlelight.
lore.legendary: Lit every candle on a hundred-candle cake before it went out.

names.legendary: The Brave Little Flame

lore.common: Flickers so close to fingers that grown-ups drop it in the sink.
lore.uncommon: Goes out in the slightest breeze.
lore.rare: Lasts exactly as long as it takes to light one candle.
lore.epic: Was passed from candle to candle round the dinner table until every one glowed.
lore.legendary: Stayed lit through a gust of wind long enough to light the lantern that guided everyone home.

names.legendary: The Lens That Found a Tiny Zoo

lore.common: Makes everyone close one eye and squint until their face aches.
lore.uncommon: Has two knobs, and everyone twists the wrong one until the slide cracks.
lore.rare: Shows the pond water is full of wriggling creatures, and nobody drinks from the tap that day.
lore.epic: Showed the whole class a drop of rainwater, and thirty children gasped at the same time.
lore.legendary: Found a tiny new creature in a puddle in the playground, and it was named after the school.

names.legendary: Sir Monocle the Very Distinguished

lore.common: Pops out of the eye whenever its wearer raises an eyebrow in surprise.
lore.uncommon: Drops into the teacup at every fancy tea party.
lore.rare: Glints in the light so that everyone thinks the wearer is very clever.
lore.epic: Popped out at the same moment as every monocle at the fancy dress party, and the floor was covered.
lore.legendary: Was worn by a dog in a costume competition, and the dog has been insufferable ever since.

names.legendary: The Dish That Grew a Rainbow

lore.common: Grows fuzzy spots that nobody wants to look at.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that slides off whenever it's carried.
lore.rare: Grows a different coloured mould in every corner, like a tiny garden.
lore.epic: Was forgotten in the science fridge over the holidays, and the whole class had a very smelly first day back.
lore.legendary: Grew a mould that turned out to be useful, and a scientist got very excited about it.

names.legendary: The Candle That Burned for a Week

lore.common: Burns a tunnel down its middle so the wick drowns in wax.
lore.uncommon: Drips down one side until it looks like a melting snowman.
lore.rare: Makes shadows dance on the wall that look like little monsters.
lore.epic: Lit every table at the candlelit dinner, and the restaurant forgot to turn the lights on.
lore.legendary: Burned for a whole week during a power cut and kept a family company the entire time.

names.legendary: The Loo at the End of the Field

lore.common: Has a door that sticks so you have to shout for help.
lore.uncommon: Always has the longest queue at any event.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that people hold their breath from three metres away.
lore.epic: Had a queue at the festival so long that people made friends and swapped phone numbers in it.
lore.legendary: Survived a whole muddy festival weekend, and still had a toilet roll left on Sunday.

names.legendary: The Toilet That Survived a Storm

lore.common: Wobbles every time someone walks past.
lore.uncommon: Has a lock that shows engaged even when it's empty.
lore.rare: Has been to more building sites than any of the builders.
lore.epic: Tipped over on its back at the building site, with nobody inside, luckily.
lore.legendary: Stood upright through a gale that blew away three tents, two gazebos and a bouncy castle.

names.legendary: The Potty That Made Everyone Proud

lore.common: Gets carried into the living room at the worst possible moment.
lore.uncommon: Plays a little tune when it's used, and the toddler cheers.
lore.rare: Makes every toddler feel like a big kid when they use it.
lore.epic: Was celebrated so loudly that the neighbours came round to see what was happening.
lore.legendary: Trained four toddlers in one family, and each one got a sticker chart and a cheer.

names.legendary: The Gauge That Measured the Flood

lore.common: Overflows in a storm before anyone can read it.
lore.uncommon: Gets checked every morning by a grandad who loves telling everyone the number.
lore.rare: Measured the rain so carefully that the weather forecaster asked for its numbers.
lore.epic: Filled to the top every day in the wettest week ever, and the garden became a pond.
lore.legendary: Measured the biggest rainstorm in a hundred years, and its number is in the record books.

names.legendary: The Mirror That Saw the Sticker Fight

lore.common: Tilts so the driver sees the roof instead of the road.
lore.uncommon: Watches the back seat so closely that every whisper is heard.
lore.rare: Has fuzzy dice hanging from it that swing on every corner.
lore.epic: Caught the whole back-seat sticker fight on a long drive, and everyone got told off.
lore.legendary: Saw a lost puppy following the car for three miles and got it home safely.

names.legendary: The Heap That Hid a Bicycle

lore.common: Is surrounded by seagulls arguing over a crust.
lore.uncommon: Smells so bad on hot days that the flies wear nose pegs.
lore.rare: Hides a treasure in every corner for those brave enough to look.
lore.epic: Was searched by the whole family looking for a lost ring, and they found three bikes and a teapot.
lore.legendary: Hid a perfectly good bicycle that a boy repaired and rode for ten years.

names.legendary: The Clock That Ran on Sand

lore.common: Gets knocked over so the sand runs the wrong way.
lore.uncommon: Tilts on its stand so the timing is always a bit off.
lore.rare: Times the tea brewing so perfectly that every cup is just right.
lore.epic: Timed every round of the family board game, and the whole family argued over every second.
lore.legendary: Has timed every pot of tea in the same kitchen for fifty years.

names.legendary: The Candle That Smelled of Summer

lore.common: Mixes its smell with dinner, so the house smells of lavender lasagne.
lore.uncommon: Says sea breeze on the label but smells like washing powder.
lore.rare: Makes every room feel so cosy that nobody wants to leave.
lore.epic: Was lit in every room at once for a spa night, and the whole house smelled like a garden.
lore.legendary: Smelled so much like summer that a family lit it every winter evening to remember their holiday.

names.legendary: The Skip That Ate a Whole House

lore.common: Takes up the whole driveway, so cars have to park on the grass.
lore.uncommon: Fills up with the neighbours' junk the moment it's delivered.
lore.rare: Gets a wheelbarrow tipped into it every five minutes.
lore.epic: Was filled with every old sofa on the street in one weekend.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a whole house's worth of rubbish during a renovation, and still had room for a bathtub.

names.legendary: The Globe With a Real Winter Inside

lore.common: Gets shaken so hard that the little snowman falls over.
lore.uncommon: Swirls its snow round and round until everyone gets dizzy.
lore.rare: Holds a whole tiny village that nobody can ever visit.
lore.epic: Was shaken by every child in the shop, and the shelf turned into a blizzard.
lore.legendary: Was shaken on a hot summer's day, and the whole room felt chilly for an hour.

names.legendary: The Can That Was Recycled Forever

lore.common: Gets squashed flat by every passing car.
lore.uncommon: Gets kicked along the pavement by every bored child.
lore.rare: Rattles down the street in the wind like a tiny drum.
lore.epic: Was picked up by every volunteer on recycling day, and the bins were full by lunch.
lore.legendary: Was recycled so many times that it has been a bike, a can, a plane and a can again.

names.legendary: The Sparkler That Wrote in the Sky

lore.common: Fizzes so close to your gloves that everyone tells you to hold it further away.
lore.uncommon: Writes your name in the air, which disappears before anyone can read it.
lore.rare: Throws sparks in every direction like a tiny fountain of stars.
lore.epic: Was lit by the whole family at once in the garden, and the dark sky filled with swirling light.
lore.legendary: Wrote a whole birthday message in the air so fast that the camera caught every letter.

names.legendary: The Dial That Never Needed Winding

lore.common: Stops working every time a cloud goes past.
lore.uncommon: Points its shadow at the time, but always an hour off in summer.
lore.rare: Tells the time so accurately on a sunny day that nobody needs a watch.
lore.epic: Confused the whole garden party when the clocks changed, and everyone was late for the cake.
lore.legendary: Has told the time in the same garden for three hundred years without a single battery.

names.legendary: The Scratch That Kept Everyone Well

lore.common: Makes everyone look away the moment they see it.
lore.uncommon: Is over in a quick scratch before anyone has time to say ouch.
lore.rare: Makes even the most nervous child feel brave afterwards, especially with a sticker.
lore.epic: Gave the whole school its vaccines in one morning, and everyone got a sticker.
lore.legendary: Helped keep a whole town healthy through a long winter, one tiny scratch at a time.

names.legendary: The Light Behind a Hundred Lanterns

lore.common: Burns out in an hour and leaves a little tin cup behind.
lore.uncommon: Floats in a bowl of water like a tiny boat.
lore.rare: Fits inside every lantern in the house and makes them all glow.
lore.epic: Lined the whole garden path at the party, and guests followed the glow to the cake.
lore.legendary: Lit a hundred paper lanterns at the festival, and the whole river glowed.

names.legendary: The Telescope That Found a New Star

lore.common: Gets pointed at the neighbour's chimney instead of the stars.
lore.uncommon: Shows everything upside down, which takes ages to get used to.
lore.rare: Finds the moon so clearly that you can see every crater.
lore.epic: Was looked through by every child at the star party, and the queue went down the hill.
lore.legendary: Spotted a new comet before anyone else, and the comet was named after the girl who looked.

names.legendary: Doctor Testsworth of the Lab

lore.common: Is put down on the table and rolls straight off.
lore.uncommon: Fizzes over the top if anything is added too fast.
lore.rare: Changes colour so dramatically that the class claps.
lore.epic: Was mixed up with every other tube in the lab, and the experiment made pink foam everywhere.
lore.legendary: Held the experiment that made a famous scientist realise she'd discovered something new.

names.legendary: The Rack That Held Twelve Experiments

lore.common: Holds every tube except the one that rolls off.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on the bench so all the tubes rattle.
lore.rare: Keeps the science lab so tidy that the teacher can find everything.
lore.epic: Held every experiment at the science fair in a long colourful row.
lore.legendary: Has held the experiments of three generations of science students and never dropped one.

names.legendary: The Thermometer That Said You Were Fine

lore.common: Tickles under your tongue and makes you giggle.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when it's done, but never when you expect.
lore.rare: Always says you're perfectly fine just as you were hoping for a day off.
lore.epic: Checked every child in the class during flu season, and the school nurse ran out of stickers.
lore.legendary: Has checked every family member's temperature for twenty years and never been wrong.

names.legendary: The Cistern That Sang All Night

lore.common: Gurgles so loudly while refilling that the whole house hears.
lore.uncommon: Has a chain to pull that's always just out of reach.
lore.rare: Drips from its overflow pipe onto the garden path.
lore.epic: Refilled so loudly in the middle of the night that everyone in the house woke up.
lore.legendary: Has refilled itself a million times in the same house and still sings while it does it.

names.legendary: The Holder That Was Never Empty

lore.common: Springs its little bar out and onto the floor when you change the roll.
lore.uncommon: Sits empty for days because nobody wants to change the roll.
lore.rare: Spins the roll so fast that it unrolls across the floor.
lore.epic: Unrolled the whole roll when the cat batted it, and the bathroom became a paper river.
lore.legendary: Was never once left empty in a house of six, which nobody can explain.

names.legendary: The Fluffiest Seat in the House

lore.common: Slides off the seat whenever someone sits down.
lore.uncommon: Is so fluffy that it looks like a small sheep.
lore.rare: Makes the bathroom feel so cosy that people stay too long.
lore.epic: Was put on every toilet in the house for a cold winter, and the whole family stopped complaining.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same seat warm for twenty winters and never once slipped off.

names.legendary: The Tank That Never Stopped Running

lore.common: Rattles its heavy lid whenever someone walks past.
lore.uncommon: Keeps running water all night until someone jiggles the handle.
lore.rare: Has a float inside that everyone fiddles with but nobody understands.
lore.epic: Ran all night in the hotel room next door, and nobody slept.
lore.legendary: Has been jiggled by the same grandad every night for thirty years.

names.legendary: The Torch That Lit the Great Hall

lore.common: Waves its flame so wildly in the wind that everyone keeps a safe distance.
lore.uncommon: Hangs on the castle wall in an iron holder, just like in the stories.
lore.rare: Leaves a trail of black smoke along the ceiling.
lore.epic: Lit the whole castle during the torchlight tour, and visitors felt like knights.
lore.legendary: Lit the great hall for a feast that lasted till dawn, and never went out.

names.legendary: The Bag That Made It Down the Stairs

lore.common: Is always full when someone is in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Drips something sticky on the stairs on the way out.
lore.rare: Is always just too big for the bin it's supposed to go in.
lore.epic: Was carried down every flat's stairs on bin day, and the lift was full of rubbish.
lore.legendary: Made it down five flights of stairs without a single rip, and the family cheered.

names.legendary: The Head That Turned for the View

lore.common: Gets stuck mid-swivel so the camera points at the ground.
lore.uncommon: Has a tiny bubble level that never settles in the middle.
lore.rare: Pans so smoothly that every video looks like a film.
lore.epic: Turned slowly round a whole mountain range, and the panorama filled a whole wall.
lore.legendary: Filmed the sunrise from the same hill every morning for a year, and the video made everyone cry.

names.legendary: The Stall With the Best View

lore.common: Splashes back so everyone takes a step back.
lore.uncommon: Has a smelly block in it that never seems to shrink.
lore.rare: Is always the wrong height for half the people using it.
lore.epic: Was used by every football fan at half-time, and the queue went round the stadium.
lore.legendary: Has a little window with a view of the mountains, the best in the whole country.

names.legendary: The Mirror at the Bottom of the Stairs

lore.common: Gets a quick hair check from everyone leaving the house.
lore.uncommon: Is used for selfies so often that it has fingerprints at selfie height.
lore.rare: Makes a small hallway look like a ballroom.
lore.epic: Was checked by every guest arriving at the party, and the hallway jammed.
lore.legendary: Has watched every family member leave for their first day of school for fifty years.

names.legendary: The Stove That Kept the Cottage Warm

lore.common: Eats logs so fast that someone has to keep going out into the snow.
lore.uncommon: Has a glass door that shows the dancing flames.
lore.rare: Keeps a kettle on top that's always warm for tea.
lore.epic: Kept the whole cottage warm during the snowstorm, and the family played cards all week.
lore.legendary: Kept a mountain hut warm through a whole winter, and every hiker who stopped there thanked it.
